programme.title: Jeremy Fink and Meaning Of Life
Jeremy Fink and Meaning Of Life
Blippi's Singapore Adventures
programme.desc: Blippi is exploring the wonders of Singapore! First, he visits Jewel Changi Airport to navigate a giant maze and see the massive indoor waterfall! Then, Blippi has fun exploring the beach and testing how fast he can go! He slides at Splash Tribe, conquers the huge HydroDash water obstacle course and rides a luge down a big hill. It's a Singapore adventure!

programme.title: Blippi's Singapore Adventures
programme.desc: Join Blippi for a tasty adventure in Singapore! He dives into Peranakan culture at Kim Choo Kueh Chong, exploring traditional clothing and tasting delicious kueh. Then, he learns to make Ondeh Ondeh and Nyonya Rice Dumplings! Get ready to play traditional games like Five Stones and have a colorful dough adventure while exploring the traditions of Singapore!

programme.title: Blippi's Top 10
programme.desc: Get ready to play! Blippi is counting down his top 10 favorite moments of fun and games. This energetic compilation features Blippi learning new sports, exploring amazing playgrounds, and discovering all sorts of fun ways to play. It's a celebration of being active, learning new skills, and having a great time.

programme.title: Blippi's Top 10
programme.desc: Blippi has so many buddies that he loves! There's Meekah, and TABBS, and DBO and all of the friends he meets on his adventures. Blippi invites his buddies at home to join him in remembering some of his favorite moments spent with friends. Awwww!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is on adventures big and small, from the mail to outer space! First, Blippi shrinks down to go inside the BlippiMobile's engine to fix a problem. Then, he follows a letter he wrote on its entire journey through the post office to Grandpa Blippi's mailbox! After that, he flies into outer space on a rocket, floating in zero gravity and performing a space walk. He even joins a boulder on its exciting trip down a river to become a grain of sand!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is wondering, 'How does it work?!' Join Blippi and his robot buddy FETCH on an adventure to find the answers! Blippi shrinks down to fly inside a beehive and learn how honey is made, and explores a garbage truck to find out why flies love it so much. Then, it's a trip through a factory to see how chocolate is made! The adventure even travels through time as Blippi meets his great-grandpa to see the very first cars. Plus, Blippi and FETCH help a nervous crane learn to build a skyscraper!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is answering some of life's biggest questions! He shrinks down for a night adventure in a mouth to learn the right way to brush teeth from Bill Brushy. Then, he flies up a nose to find out what makes us sneeze! His curiosity continues as he learns how a fly can walk upside down on the ceiling, discovers the artistic process of how spiders make their webs and even becomes a contestant on a game show to learn the difference between fruits and vegetables!

programme.title: Blippi's Singapore Adventures
programme.desc: Join Blippi for a big nature adventure in Singapore! Blippi learns all about local honey bees, collecting honey and tasting honey ice cream! Then, he discovers what it takes to be a zookeeper at the Singapore Zoo and River Wonders. He talks to a parrot, hugs pelicans, feeds a capybara and meets a 90-year-old tortoise! It's a wild day in Singapore!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Let's slip and slide! Join Blippi as he explores Soak City Water Park. Big rides, lots of water and lots of learning for kids in this educational Blippi video for kids! Learn colors, shapes and more!

programme.title: Blippi's Ultimate Playdates
programme.desc: Join Blippi for ultimate playdates full of action! First, Blippi and Everest play a vehicle scavenger hunt at an indoor playground, learning about teamwork. Then, get ready to rock out with Miles Music Kid for a remix of 'Curious Like Me' and an awesome dance party! The fun continues in the Fun Food Kitchen for the Mystery Box Food Challenge, where they guess wacky foods just by touching them!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Blippi is exploring some mighty machines at work! First, he visits a construction yard to learn all about skid steers. He explores all the parts of the skid steer, inside and out, while learning how they work and how they're used. Then, Blippi takes you for a ride inside a real forklift! He learns about these amazing construction trucks as he explores all their different parts before trying his hand at lifting something with the forklift himself!

programme.title: Blippi's Singapore Adventures
programme.desc: Get active with Blippi in Singapore! Blippi explores all kinds of animals, pretending to be an ant and learning that humans are animals too! Then, he and his buddy Asa find ways to move their bodies at Kiztopia in Singapore, playing in a ball pit and doing a ninja obstacle course! The fun continues at the Singapore Zoo where Blippi feeds lemurs and gives a big elephant a pedicure!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi on a sense-ational journey! He visits a garden to discover his five senses, exploring the flavors of fruit and colors of flowers. His nature-filled day continues at a gorgeous greenhouse where he plants a seed and learns how water, nutrition and sunlight help plants grow. He names all the colors and learns about flowers, picking a beautiful bouquet.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: It's another brand new Blippi adventure for kids! Today Blippi visits Great Explorations Children's Museum in St. Petersburg, Florida. What do you want to be when you grow up? A chef? A vet? A doctor? Learn with Blippi as he teaches your children about different careers and jobs for kids.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Blippi is having loads of fun at LOL Kids Club! Join him as he visits two of their amazing locations. In one colorful playground, Blippi will teach us about lots of different shapes, colors, animals and more! Then, at another LOL Kids Club indoor play place, Blippi learns through playing! He'll help us learn about colors, shapes, size comparison and so much more! It's a day packed with learning and laughter!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi for two of his biggest challenges ever! First, Blippi wants to create the ultimate ball pit by filling a giant bouncy castle with thousands of balls in the silliest way possible! Then, for his 10th Anniversary, Blippi celebrates with a trip to a candy escape room. He and his friends must solve silly challenges and beat the clock, or a delicious dessert prize will get squished by a real excavator! Can they finish in time?

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: It's a vroom vroom vehicle adventure with Blippi! He starts his day at a children's museum where he learns all about cars and fuel. After learning about go-karts, he's ready to race! Blippi puts on his helmet and tries to beat his own record on the track. The day ends with the biggest trucks he's ever seen... Monster Trucks! Blippi learns all about these awesome vehicles and even gets to go for a once-in-a-lifetime ride.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi on some amazing adventures, both near and far! First, Blippi heads all the way to India to ride in a rickshaw tuk-tuk! While he's there, he also gets to taste some delicious coconut water. Then, Blippi is back home exploring Tenino, Washington on a bicycle! He visits an outdoor play park, a fire station and more as he learns about being active and exploring the world around him!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi as he becomes a baker for a day! Blippi visits his friend Lior the Baker to bake some tasty treats. He learns all about lots of different utensils you can find in the kitchen, like whisks, bowls and measuring cups. After his lesson, Blippi is ready to try his hand at baking. Get ready to make some delicious bread with Blippi!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: It's time to learn some new sports with Blippi and Meekah! First, they visit The HUB Sports Center where they get to play all sorts of fun games with their friends. Then, Blippi visits Hwang's Taekwondo martial arts school to learn a new skill. He learns about the history and cultural significance of taekwondo and works with an instructor to master some exciting beginner-level moves. It's a day full of movement, learning and fun!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Blippi embarks on a sweet treat adventure! He visits a chocolate shop to learn how delectable sweets are made, becoming a confectioner for the day. Then his culinary journey continues at a local bakery where he visits the kitchen to learn how to bake a variety of tasty goods, all while learning about healthy eating.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: It's another brand new Blippi adventure for kids! Today Blippi visits Great Explorations Children's Museum in St. Petersburg, Florida. What do you want to be when you grow up? A chef? A vet? A doctor? Learn with Blippi as he teaches your children about different careers and jobs for kids.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Blippi learns all about bowling in this episode featuring the great indoors. There's always fun to be had even when the weather doesn't cooperate and Blippi knows just how to find it! Blippi learns the proper way to roll a bowling ball and how to knock down the pins for a strike!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is your guide to having fun and healthy days! First, have some fun in the sun while learning from Señor Super Sunscreen how to apply sunscreen properly. Then, shrink down with Blippi and Meekah as they travel to Italy to learn how to make an authentic pizza! The adventure continues as Blippi helps a bear get ready for winter hibernation. After a long day of fun, it's time for bed, as a magical book reads a bedtime story about the benefits of a good night's rest!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is learning fun facts all about the world! He and D.BO shrink down to meet Ernie the Eraser, an aspiring magician who teaches them the science behind how erasers work. Then, they fly into the night sky to learn how fireworks get their colors and why some animals, like raccoons, prefer to come out at night. The adventure continues as Blippi learns how to be a cowboy in the desert and helps a brave spoon protect his cereal from getting soggy!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is on adventures big and small, from the mail to outer space! First, Blippi shrinks down to go inside the BlippiMobile's engine to fix a problem. Then, he follows a letter he wrote on its entire journey through the post office to Grandpa Blippi's mailbox! After that, he flies into outer space on a rocket, floating in zero gravity and performing a space walk. He even joins a boulder on its exciting trip down a river to become a grain of sand!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: It's a strange night for the Oddbods! Slick fancies himself a great dancer, but he's terrible! When he discovers the truth, Jeff is kind enough to offer his services and soon transforms him into quite the mover. Then, Fuse's perfect night's sleep is interrupted by an intruder: a very resilient and resourceful mouse! Who will triumph in this battle of wills? Finally, Slick and Newt go on a date, but things don't go as planned when Newt is infected by a werewolf!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are facing new challenges! Pogo is shunned by everyone after his latest prank backfires, so he ventures to prove that he's a changed Bod. Then, Slick enlists Bubbles as his dance partner for an upcoming competition but is horrified to realize that she's the worst dancer ever! How will he get out of this commitment? Finally, Slick recruits Newt to be his assistant for his latest ambition: to be a great magician!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: It's story time with JJ's favorite songs and stories! First, sing along to 'Wheels on the Bus' as JJ and his friends put on an interactive show. Then, settle in for some classic tales. Watch as the three little pigs try to build houses strong enough to keep the Big Bad Wolf away. Then, find out who wins a big race: the speedy hare or the slow and steady tortoise! Finally, learn a lesson about working hard with the story of the Grasshopper and the Ants.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Join JJ for a guide to staying healthy and happy! The learning starts with hygiene, as JJ and his friends learn the importance of washing their hands and how to scrub-a-dub-dub in the bath. Then, it's time for some big milestones! Sing along as JJ learns to use the potty and TomTom learns what happens when you lose a tooth. Plus, join the Melon Patch kids as they visit the doctor for a checkup and learn that it's nothing to be afraid of!

programme.title: Blippi's Singapore Adventures
programme.desc: Blippi is getting creative in Singapore! First, he visits Sentosa's Trick Eye Museum to take super silly photos and create an awesome album with his buddy Emma! Then, it's a day of exploring creative jobs. Blippi meets a musician to try instruments and discovers areas for construction workers, airplane pilots and inventors. 新闻掏宝
programme.desc: 常言道：「今日新闻，明日历史」。每天那么多新闻，大家可能来不及消化，更遑论回望历史。历史就是一个大宝库，少看历史和小看历史，很容易「走宝」。新节目《新闻掏宝》带大家在宝库「掏」新闻宝藏，除了昔日特辑、直播和系列报道，还有从未曝光的珍贵片段，观众有机会重温李小龙出殡、宝生银行劫案、四人帮审讯、英女王访港、的士罢驶、中英签订联合声明、戴卓尔夫人专访、越南难民、尤德逝世、彭定康抵港、启德机场关闭、邓小平逝世、九七回归大典、华航香港空难和沙士记者会。

programme.title: Messy Goes To Okido S3, Ep 20
Jojo and Gran Gran S1, Ep 8
Messy Goes To Okido S3, Ep 21
Holy Flame Of The Martial World
Asia-pol
programme.desc: Asiapol agent Yang Ming Xuan trails a shipment of contraband gold being delivered to gang leader, George Eaton. He enlists the help of a Chinese woman who is trying to avenge her sister and narrowly escapes several deadly traps as he closes in on Eaton's location. This spy film is loosely inspired by the James Bond movies.

programme.title: The Fastest Sword
programme.desc: Southern Swordsman Ting is named "The Fastest Sword" but is defeated by a street monk and has to fulfil his promise of working on stone craving with the monk for three years. Ting returns home to lead a peaceful life after that and declines all fight challenges. Even so, he is forced to fight the Northern Swordsman. Who will win finally?

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keeper's daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle.

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress
programme.desc: The story happens in a martial arts world where everyone tries to obtain the "Deer Sword". Lian's wife is wounded in an ambush and his rival Xiao saves her. They escape to Xiao's home and he treats her poisonous wound. This leads Lian to suspect his wife's faithfulness and results in several blood-splattering duels with Xiao.

programme.title: A Place to Call Home
programme.desc: Li Ching, star of Sweet is Revenge, plays one of three daughters, whose life is turned upside down when she discovers she is adopted. But things get even worse when she goes in search of her real mother. Finally, after what is almost a double tragedy, she realizes what so many knew all along: There's no place like home.

programme.title: Five Superfighters
programme.desc: A kung fu master and his three students lost everything after they are floored by a bully. To take revenge, the students find ways to learn from other kung fu masters and come back six months later to have a rematch with the bully on their master's birthday.

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers' claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Holy Flame of the Martial World
programme.desc: Yin Tian Chou's parents were killed over a pair of flame-shaped blades. He and his sister were rescued, raised, and trained separately by a hero and a villain, each inheriting one of the blades. Sworn enemies at first, they eventually uncover their true identities and join forces to avenge their parents' deaths.

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fox
programme.desc: A young man, Chin, believes he is an orphan, until he meets three men and learns from them that his father was a great swordsman who was killed when he was trying to dispel rumors of a wrongdoing and return a lost sword to its rightful owner. Chin seeks out the men's help to take vengeance on the wrongful death of his father.

programme.title: The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: Legendary Weapons of China
programme.desc: Lei Kung, the leader of the Boxer Clan in Yunnan, dissolves the clan to save his disciples before going into self-exile. The Clan sends various assassins to kill him but failed. They then assigned Kung's brother Yong to find and kill Kung, leading to a battle between the two brothers.

programme.title: The Bride Napping
programme.desc: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fete. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servant's confusion, threatening the couple's union. After a series of complications, misunderstandings and mismatches, Chun Lan finally saves the day.

programme.title: Shaolin Rescuers
programme.desc: Hong Xi Guan of Shaolin is chased and wounded by a martial arts scum who took refuge in the Qing court. He is saved and healed by friends from the wet market and they hide Hong in a bean curd shop to protect him. However, Hong's enemy finds him and ambushes him at the shop, hoping to capture Hong and all his friends.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: The Spirit of the Sword
programme.desc: Water Clan Chief is severely wounded by a samurai killer shortly before the annual duel at Tai Lake. He sends his brother Bao Yu on a long journey to find an antidote for him. On the way, Bao Yu encounters Little Princess and falls in love with her, not knowing that she is hiding a secret plot...

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: 金沙讲坛
programme.desc: 《金沙讲坛》是中共成都市委宣传部主办，成都市社会科学院（成都市社会科学界联合会）、成都传媒集团、金沙遗址博物馆、成都市互联网宣传管理办公室、成都市广播电视和新闻出版局、各区（市）县社科联等共同承办的大型公益性文化讲坛，于2009年3月正式推出。围绕“讲成都、谈天下，通古今、论人生”的举办宗旨，讲坛坚持“选题系列化、讲师名人化、内容大众化、服务基层化、传播多元化、运作专业化”的思路，精心策划选题，邀请名家主讲，满足群众多样化的精神文化需求。在办好主讲坛现场讲座的基础上，同时推出电视版、报纸版、网络版、广播版和区（市）县分讲坛，实现“六版并进”，较好地体现了讲坛的公益性、开放性和便利性，满足了不同受众的学习需求，成为广受欢迎和喜爱的“老百姓自己的文化沙龙”。

programme.title: 每日财经
programme.desc: 《每日财经》是成都电视台经济资讯服务频道于1993年精心推出的一档以财经、证券为主要报道内容的节目。目前，《每日财经•午间版》是成都地区唯一一档午间直播的证券节目，它以其及时性和与股民的互动性，深受股民好评。而黄昏版《每日财经•晚间版》更是以全国最具分量的嘉宾和节目的专业性及权威性深深吸引了成都地区的上百万股民，成为该地区不可替代的股评谈话类节目。经过十多年的打拼，《每日财经》现已成为深入人心、口碑极好的黄金品牌栏目，并成为成都乃至四川地区优秀的证券类品牌电视节目。该节目曾获四川经济类节目二等奖。联系电话:87042828

programme.title: 李伯清书场
programme.desc: 李伯清评书，散打评书是由中国四川著名民间艺术家李伯清于上个世纪90年代在传统评书的基础上而创造出的一种新的艺术表现形式，由于其内容贴近生活，诙谐幽默，很快就在川渝地区流行开来。

programme.title: 新闻故事汇
programme.desc: 《新闻故事汇》是在原《故事汇》的基础上，进行重新的定位、创作和改版。从片名上看，虽然只是多了两个字，但这不是一种简单的添加，而是对栏目有了全新的定位和更高的要求，也决定了《新闻故事汇》要具备一定的新闻属性和新闻气质。

programme.title: 深夜快递
programme.desc: 《深夜快递》节目创办于1997年10月1日。该节目突出新闻的时效性和现场感，说新闻的主持方式和简洁明快的评论以及浓厚的人文关怀气息见长，有着自己极为鲜明和独特的节目风格，在“主流、现代、阳光”有鲜明的特色，是成都地区晚间同时段收视率最高的新闻节目之一，节目开播十多年来在观众中卓有口碑，形成了相对固定的收视群。播出时间：周一至周四21：00—22：20 ；周五至周日21：30-22：20 播出。

programme.title: 美丽人生
programme.desc: 剧团美工伍正德（李雪健饰）的儿子陪导演去省文化厅汇报对《美丽人生》剧本的修改，顺便把省城上大学的妹妹接回来，导演是团里唯一的大学生，也是他爱人赵萍萍（吴越饰）的骄傲，范月（杨梅饰），范阳（杨志刚饰）的父母是团里的台柱子，为了方便与省钱他们都蹭了剧团里的方便车，两个孩子做好了他们的第一顿饭，等待着……对于这三个家庭来说，幸福真的是刚刚开始……一场无奈的意外，除了李大川重伤以外，其他的人都死了……一切物是人非，对于这三家人来说，剩下的莫过于少年丧父，中年丧偶，老年丧子，两个孩子没有了依靠，赵萍萍昏倒在医院里的地板上，伤痛留下的只有苦痛的人生……血浓情感悄然而至心火点燃，在满院子惊诧的目光中，四个人组成了“临时家庭”感受温暖，重新寻找家的港湾。

programme.title: 有话好好说
programme.desc: 《有话好好说》以栏目剧形式表现现实生活中人与人之间的矛盾冲突，在记者帮忙解决矛盾的过程中，传递人生真谛。 该剧采用新闻拍摄的方式进行拍摄，从内容和形式上贴近百姓生活、百姓话题，不讲什么大道理，更多关心的是家长里短，因为小事才能反映生活中的矛盾，戏中看他人矛盾，从中感悟生活大道理，凡事《有话好好说》。热线电话：84333024

programme.title: 养生龙门阵
programme.desc: 《养生龙门阵》是一档30分钟的演播室互动访谈类健康养生电视节目。

programme.title: 红绿灯
programme.desc: 《红绿灯》一档交通类节目，为市民进行交通信息服务、文明交通、平安出行的引导以及进行《道法》的普法教育。

programme.title: 热线188
programme.desc: 《热线188》栏目是成都电视台都市生活频道的一档日播类新闻直播节目，每晚八点一小时直播。栏目依照“记者在您身边，架起沟通的桥梁”的宗旨，立足成都本地，注重新闻报道的趣味化、贴近性，注重舆论引导，弘扬社会正气；注重用百姓眼光，解读重大时政主题；注重为百姓服务、关注百姓生活；注重快速反应，及时播报重大性、突发性事件；注重舆论监督，保证媒体监督的力度和权威性。《热线188》：您关心的就是我们所关注的！时长60分

programme.title: 920在行动
programme.desc: 《920在行动》栏目是一档关注民生，曝光丑恶，聚焦社会热点的新闻类专题节目,在成都地区独领风骚。其情感介入、真人体验、测试类等节目形态在成都地区绝无仅有，让观众喜闻乐见。节目贴近生活、贴近民生，情感帮助，又富于教育性、实用性和趣味性。在这档节奏明快、形式独特的节目中，真情在涌动，文明在传递，沟通在继续，栏目在以自身的实践不断践行自己的责任，提升着社会公德。自开播以来，栏目播出了大量具有较强影响力的节目，如5.12地震系列节目《生还娃娃牵动万人心》、《感动中国的敬礼》、《永远的芭蕾》等，曝光酒托的节目《昂贵的约会》、系列解救被拐儿童的节目《千里解救》等等。栏目的口号是:“感触人间冷暖，行动凝聚力量”。

programme.title: 相亲进行时
programme.desc: 相亲进行时，爱开始的地方！《相亲进行时》栏目是成都地区唯一一档婚恋交友类真人秀节目。西南地区最大最具公信力的征婚交友平台，也是国内影响力最大的征婚交友平台之一。节目中汇集了大量的白领、精英人士，而且节目一直秉承了以风趣幽默的方式，记录现代都市人相亲故事的形式。栏目利用品牌优势、明星资源和优质的节目，继续不断的为精英单身人士提供良好的征婚交友平台。目前《相亲进行时》是成都地区娱乐类节目冠军，收视人群也是成都地区所有栏目中最年轻化的栏目，成都电视台都市生活频道品牌栏目。 开播三年来，为万余名会员牵起了浪漫的情缘，而且已经拥有了近2万名的会员基础。《相亲进行时》共策划执行活动数四十余次，除了每月的万人大型相亲会，还有隔周举行的各类中小型相亲活动。活动地点除了分布在成都市市内，还在广安、绵阳、龙泉驿、新都、郫县、都江堰、彭州以及邛崃开展了丰富多样的相亲活动，并且推广到杭州、香港等地。这些活动的高质量、高密度，参与人数之多，市场反应之强烈，堪称成都媒介活动的典范。除此之外，《相亲进行时》还利用其良好的品牌和口碑，策划和举办了多个大型全民参与类的活动，如《蝶变新生》、《瘦身无穷动》、《奥运集结号》、《人人都有戏》等等，《相亲进行时》为推广成都市的知名度、美誉度，贡献了自己的力量。

programme.desc: 《陈岳叔叔讲故事》栏目原是成都电视台影视文艺频道于2001年元月1日推出的儿童栏目，于2005年2月1日开始在成都电视台少儿频道播出，是少儿频道主打栏目。该栏目开播以来长期位居成都地区同类型节目中收视率之首，多次主办大型社会活动，是成都及周边地区最有影响力和号召力的儿童栏目。2004年下半年开始该栏目还在辽宁、西安、南宁、乌鲁木齐等省市台播出，是在全国都有一定影响的少儿栏目。主持人为成都地区著名少儿节目主持人陈岳（陈首军）。

programme.title: 乐豆逗斗堂之乐豆生日会
programme.desc: 少儿现场互动电视栏目《乐豆逗斗堂》创办于2010年，以成都电视台少儿频道卡通形象“乐豆”命名，是一档针对少儿的参与性强、互动性强的电视栏目，节目以游戏和竞技题为主要内容，每期邀请60名左右小观众参与，以其“零门槛”的参与条件，为成都市广大少儿朋友提供了一个展示自我的平台。栏目自播出后反响热烈，已吸引本市数十所学校、幼儿园的数万名小观众来台参与节目，影响力逐步扩大，2011年获国家广电总局全国优秀少儿电视栏目鼓励奖。该栏目目前设置有“快乐宝贝”版（针对学龄前儿童）和“活力少年”版（针对小学生）两个板块。为扩大栏目的影响力和参与面，2012年该栏目还将推出周末家庭版，以家庭为单位组织观众参与节目，内容为亲子游戏竞技等，以吸引更多的观众参与到该栏目中来。每天19:30-20：04播出，每周六期（周六-周四），主持人为海洋老师（宋海洋）、静学姐（李静）、豆豆哥哥（温镜涵）、糖果姐姐（沈丹）。

Every Monday to Friday, it provides nutrition to form your own thoughts and ideas through live debate and interviews. Live debates linking movers and shakers take place in the signature segment "Global Debate".

programme.title: The World Today
programme.desc: The core rolling news service of CGTN, with regular updates from Beijing, Washington, Nairobi and London, keep viewers up-to-date with all the world’s top stories as they happen. The World Today delivers breaking news, live events, in-depth reporting, expert analysis and sustained coverage.

programme.title: The Vibe
programme.desc: The Vibe is a 30-minute TV show that runs daily on weekdays on CGTN. The content focuses on exciting new trends, fashion, and cultural topics across a range of disciplines both in China and abroad. The host presents various culture-related topics in a fun way while also doing some in-depth analysis to give viewers a fuller picture as to what is happening, and why it matters.

Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family's massacre years ago. While taking on the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that was planned for years and has to use his skills as an assassin to solve whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building - only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: Skyline Cruisers
programme.desc: Four professional thieves are tasked with stealing a cancer vaccine, but they are shocked to discover a pre-set bomb in the laboratory and realize it is a setup against them. Suddenly, a mysterious girl appears, holding a crucial clue that could unravel the conspiracy...

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud's successor as the city's guard.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend.

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar's gang when he saves the gang's elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley's mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei's possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: THEATER DRAMA : LAGI-LAGI MENGEJAR CINTA OLGA [P13]
programme.desc: A program drama FTV about love, friendship, family, happy, sad etc, played by popular actor and actress Indonesia.

programme.title: MENCINTAI IPAR SENDIRI EPS 101 [P13]
programme.desc: Ayuna, a beauty vlogger and model, finishes a shoot and is picked up by her younger sister, Bella. Bella takes Ayuna to a workshop to give her a surprise: Ayuna’s sports car has been upgraded as a gift, since Bella is getting married before her older sister. Bella then asks Ayuna to have one last race on a deserted road as her farewell to the racing world, a request that Ayuna agrees to with a heavy heart.

programme.title: 99 NAMA CINTA 26 [P13]
programme.desc: Talia lives under the spotlight of cameras and the heat of celebrity news. Since her fiancé passed away, she has kept her heart tightly closed. To her, love only brings loss. Meanwhile, Kiblat is a respected young ustad—calm, courteous, and firm in his principles. His life is well-directed—until an incident brings him face-to-face with Talia in a heated argument over a minor accident. They instantly dislike each other. Unbeknownst to them, their parents have long been bound by a promise: to arrange their children’s marriage. When Hasanah, Kiblat’s mother, falls ill and pleads to see her son married before it’s too late, Kiblat is faced with a great dilemma—follow his heart or fulfill his duty to his parents.

programme.title: KESETIAAN JANJI CINTA EPS 44 [P13]
programme.desc: Meira no longer feels happy in her marriage. Lately, Arya, her husband, constantly looks for faults in her. As a result, Meira and Arya often get into arguments. The situation reaches its peak when Arya refuses to provide for Meira anymore. He even refuses to help cover the medical expenses of Meira’s mother, Siti. Arya also stops paying for Lani’s college tuition, Meira’s younger sister. Even though, before they got married, it was Arya who promised Meira that he would cover all of her living expenses as well as her family’s, so that she could focus on being a housewife.

programme.title: CINTA BERAKHIR BAHAGIA 16 [P13]
programme.desc: Adisty, a beautiful young woman who serves as the backbone of her family, nearly becomes a sex worker to pay off her family’s debts. However, fate brings her together with Pasha, a respectable man from a wealthy family. Unbeknownst to them, they were actually switched at birth. What will happen to Adisty and Pasha’s lives?

programme.title: TEBARAN HATI EPS 66 [P13]
programme.desc: This story begins with Ariana, a renowned reporter and the adopted daughter of the respected Prawira family. She is willing to sacrifice everything to protect the good name of the family that raised her. When Ladya, her adopted younger sister, becomes depressed after getting pregnant out of wedlock and being abandoned by her boyfriend who flees abroad, to the point of attempting suicide, Ariana is asked by her adoptive mother, Indar, to claim the baby as her own. This decision shatters Ariana’s career and calls off her wedding to Kai, her boyfriend from a wealthy family.

programme.title: FS MMA Diego Gonzalez vs. Matt Thorpe
programme.desc: BodogFIGHT features classic MMA matches involving some of your favorite fighters! Diego 'The Silencer' Gonzalez locks horns with Matt '12 Gauge' Thorpe. An action packed welterweight bout in St. Petersburg, Russia sees these two fighters go the distance.

programme.title: MEGA Fights Carlos Manuel Baldomir vs. Arturo Gatti
programme.desc: MEGA Fights are premiere events from the sport of boxing including HBO World Championship Boxing and historic PPV events plus past, current and future World Champions. This episode features welterweights Carlos Manuel Baldomir, aka 'Tata' (42-9, 12 KOs) vs. Arturo 'Thunder' Gatti (40-7, 31 KOs) in a bout to unify the WBC and IBA titles. The fight took place at Boardwalk Hall in Atlantic City, New Jersey, USA, on July 22, 2006.

programme.title: Fukuoka 2023 - Episode 1
programme.desc: Fukuoka, Japan welcomes the top talent in the world of martial arts when Karate 1 Premier League returns. Fukuoka will host athletes from across the globe including last season's Grand Winners such as Hikaru Ono and Ayaka Saito competing in their home country. The World Karate Federation expects another tremendous turnout, featuring Olympic medalists and world-ranked competitors, when the Karate 1 Premier League visits the port city of Fukuoka, Japan, on FIGHT SPORTS.

programme.title: Men's Forms Championship
programme.desc: This episode features highlights from the CMX Weapons Championship and the Men's Forms Championship at the ISKA US Open Championships held at Disney World, Orlando, FL, USA.

programme.title: MEGA Fights Jan Zaveck vs. Andre Berto
programme.desc: MEGA Fights are premiere events from the sport of boxing including HBO World Championship Boxing and historic PPV events plus past, current and future World Champions. This episode features the IBF Welterweight title bout, Jan Zaveck, aka 'Mr. Sympathicus', (31-1, 18 KOs) vs. Andre Berto (27-1, 21 KOs) from Beau Rivage Resort and Casino in Biloxi, Mississippi, USA, on September 3, 2011. Andre Berto, coming off losing the WBC title to Victor Ortiz, was looking for vengeance against Zaveck.

programme.title: Biomechanics of Body Preparation
programme.desc: In this episode we follow one of our martial artists as he goes through a grueling tournament and how he uses technology to help him prepare for it.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! Joe Calzaghe vs. Roy Jones, Jr.
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is a light heavyweight championship fight featuring Joe Calzaghe and Roy Jones, Jr. This epic bout would prove to be the last of Calzage's career. Many wanted him to retire because he had nothing left to prove, and Calzaghe would officially do so 3 months later. Also on the card, Chris Arreola shows everyone why he is a heavyweight contender.

programme.title: Osaka, Japan: Show 4
programme.desc: Top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. programme.title: Hague Grand Prix
programme.desc: Judo for the World features the best competitors in the sport as they compete in a global tour for an opportunity to vie for the gold in the World Judo Championship. In this episode we see the best Judo from the Hague Grand Prix and we follow some of Netherlands' judo heroes as they try to mark the event with a medal tally to be proud of.

programme.title: Pariah: Sonny Liston
programme.desc: Was Sonny Liston murdered? This four-part documentary series explores the life and untimely death of boxing legend Charles 'Sonny' Liston, who became the heavyweight champion of the world when he knocked out Floyd Patterson in 1962. Unfortunately, just eight years later, he was found dead in his Las Vegas home from an alleged heroin overdose. Suspicion regarding the real cause of his death has continued to this day. Episode 1 of 4.

programme.desc: CombiNATION Plates is television's best travel show that never leaves the kitchen. Skilled Chef Craig Wong is your host, and prepare to be blown away by his takes on the foods of France and Vietnam. First up? Marrow Toast dresses up in its tux and tails for a version made with King Oyster Mushrooms and Sauce Bordelaise. The common ingredient is Baguette; check out supersonic versions of French Jambon Beurre and Vietnamese Banh Mi. The Big Dish blends delicate sole with ProvencÌ§ale flavour spiked Nuoc Cham and a crunchy Haricot Amandine inspired Vietnamese crepe.

The Big Dish blends delicate sole with ProvencÌ§ale flavour spiked Nuoc Cham and a crunchy Haricot Amandine inspired Vietnamese crepe.

programme.title: France, Japan, Morocco, Mexico
programme.desc: Join chef Pino Di Cerbo in the Global Veggies kitchen as he creates veggie dishes inspired by France - French Fennel Soup, Japan - Unagi-Style Soy Glazed Figs, Morocco - Moroccan Butterbean Tagine, and Mexico - Asparagus Ceviche!

programme.title: French Brunch
programme.desc: Inspired by flaky, buttery, and chocolatey dishes, host Vanessa cooks up four classic French recipes that'll have you saying oh la la!

programme.title: Cassoulet
programme.desc: In this episode of Up the Dish, host Micah Trainor takes a stab at Cassoulet with buttery white beans, duck leg confit, and flavourful French sausage - and the result is mouth-wateringly good! The pressure's on, but Tiera Singh doesn't let up with her Chinese Long Bean Stir Fry. Succulent sausage, delicious duck breast, and flavorful vegetables come together for a truly sumptuous dish! For her vegetarian variant, Missy Hui must move things up a notch, but how? Agedashi Tofu! Breaded crispy semi-firm tofu is doused in a dashi, gochujang, and mirin mixture for the ultimate umami mouthful. Poppy Sandler goes above and beyond with her Chocolate-crusted Elk Loin, seared and drizzled with a decadent Coffee- Blueberry Demi-Glace - sound strange? Tastes terrific!

programme.title: In Mary's Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from another award-winning cookbook: In Mary’s Kitchen by his friend, Mary Berg! Follow along as Shahir prepares French onion pot roast, creamy lobster gnocchi, lemony piccata, and much more!

programme.title: USA + India
programme.desc: Go-to Indian menu item Lamb Rogan Josh is one thing, but Lamb Sweetbreads Rogan Josh with Aloo Gobi Foam? That's a CombiNATION Plates thing! Craig Wong is at it again in this USA + India episode. After India, Chef moves on to the USA to answer the question, 'is everything better battered and fried?' with his Country Fried Torchon of Foie Gras. The common ingredient for these two distant nations is lobster, and really, who doesn't love it? For the US, it's Lobster with Cajun Spice Grits and Pickled Okra, and for India, check out Lobster Curry with Coconut Milk. The finale features Catfish like you've never seen it. Cooked Tandoori style and served with Collard Greens Paneer and Peach Bhaji, it's a one-of-a-kind CombiNATION sensation!

programme.title: Iceland + Jamaica
programme.desc: Halibut is on the menu for Craig Wong's first stop in this episode of CombiNATION Plates for his Icelandic tribute, the firm, flaky fish is served with Lovage, BeÌarnaise, and Beet Glazed Turnips. Next, it's a Jamaican adventure on a plate featuring whole, soft-shell crab Escovitch, fried, doused in chili vinegar, and served with carrot meringue?! Check out the common ingredient: ice cream! With creamy Skyr style with Blueberries representing Iceland and an Avocado Lime sensation for Jamaica that only Chef Wong could pull off, made in mere moments with liquid nitrogen! The Big Dish is a you-could-only-find-it-here experience; Jamaican Jerk Spice Reindeer (yes, you read that right) served with Brown Stew Wild Mushrooms and Salsify.

programme.title: Ireland + Japan
programme.desc: If you are talking about Irish food, it's hard not to talk about Corned Beef and Cabbage. On this episode of CombiNATION Plates, Chef Craig Wong delivers his unusual take using Beef Cheek, modern technique, and a caraway-infused Carrot Terrine for fun! Next up is a tribute to Izakaya eats, featuring Tare Grilled Duck Hearts, Miso-roasted Mushroom, and Agedashi Tofu. The featured common ingredient is Oysters. For Ireland, it's Garlic GratineÌe; for Japan, check out the Kaki Yaki, oysters broiled with miso and rich Japanese Kewpie mayo. For the final dish, light up! Smoking is permitted! Check out blowtorch-seared and tableside-smoked Wagyu Beef, brushed with Irish Stout Teriyaki and served with Wasabi Champ Potato. Now that's a CombiNation Plate!

programme.title: Dine Your Sign - Spring Special
programme.desc: On the Dine Your Sign Spring Special, Chef Siobhan Detkavich is cooking for Aries, Taurus, and Gemini! First, quiche with the season’s most delicious gifts – tender asparagus and earthy morels – suspended in silky custard and smothered in creamy fontina cheese! Next, spring lamb is stuffed with a sprightly pesto of mint and dandelion greens and roasted with shallots and new potatoes. Then, it’s an easy, healthy halibut dish with ramps (aka ‘wild garlic’) and grassy fiddleheads – the fish is steamed and finished with a sizzling pour over oil treatment that leaves the kitchen smelling like heaven! Finally, dessert a spring sign is sure to love: buttery, flaky croissant, stuffed with rich mascarpone cheese and tangy, sweet, balsamic-marinated strawberries! Hooray Spring!

programme.title: Madagascar + Belgium
programme.desc: First up, Belgium is famous for its mussels and fries, aka 'Moule Frite'. Chef Wong has a unique take featuring Belgian beer steamed mussels salad, waffle cut fries, and potato-leek mousse. Next, Steak Madagascar is an old school fine-dining fave, this take, uses modernist 'spherification' for the sauce, and a vanilla bean rub for a steak that is decidedly not 'old school', wow! For a common ingredient, how about sweet breakfast? Belgians are famous for Liege Waffles, and Madagascar loves Mofogasy, a pancake made with rice flour and coconut. The final dish is inspired by Belgian Waterzooi, a root veggie stew, mixed with a popular Malagesy stir-fry with shellfish and pork... Chef carefully and skillfully balances all the elements, using lobster, bacon breadcrumbs, and adding a modern touch with mango pickle 'pearls'!

programme.title: Peru + Lebanon
programme.desc: Tiraditos! No, it's not a joyous exclamation (even though it sounds a little like one...) it's a Peruvian dish that lands somewhere between traditional Peruvian ceviche and Japanese sashimi. Chef Craig Wong's version is made with swordfish and includes sweet potatoes pureed with spicy Aji Amarillo chilies. For his Lebanese tribute, check out Lamb Neck cured and slow-poached in olive oil for a melt-in- your-mouth result, paired with an intense, flavourful Black Baba Ghanoush made with charred eggplant and caramelized onions. For a common ingredient, it is two takes on potato: Lomo Saltado with grilled flank steak, and a cheese, herb, olive oil and lemon drenched Hasselback Batata Harra. Squab is on the final plate blending Lebanese flavours like sumac, pomegranate, and pistachio with Peruvian ones like sweet corn, squash, and lime. What a CombiNation!

programme.title: South Africa + Portugal
programme.desc: This CombiNation Plates culinary adventure starts in Portugal with a Scallop dish that features some of their finest ingredients, such as Port Wine, ChouricÌ§o sausage, Kale, and Figs. Next up is South Africa and the feature is an Ostrich Steak, served with native Cape Gooseberries, the bizarrely named "Monkey Gland Sauce" (don't worry, no monkeys and very few glands are involved). The common ingredient is Peri Peri peppers, featured first on a Grilled Sardine with Olive Soil for a peak Portugal experience, then on the Peri Peri Chicken dish that South Africa made internationally famous. The combination plate is always the big finale... Stand back in awe for Chef Craig's Giant Braaied (aka 'grilled') Veal Chop with Clams 'Alentejana', served with a sweet-tart tropical Fruit Salad to balance the plate.

programme.desc: Chef Craig Wong loves cooking lamb, and with his expert advice, you will too!

programme.title: Traditional Japanese Food
programme.desc: Chef and cookbook author Hana Etsuko Dethlefsen schools us on traditional Japanese foods as she makes tofu rice pockets, miso glazes, and rice flour dumplings.

programme.title: Hong Kong Foodie Favourites
programme.desc: Cantonese expert Mary Tang showcases traditional dishes from the Chinese coastal territory, Hong Kong. To kick off the episode, Mary rolls up and steams a batch of fluffy Shrimp Dumplings. Next, tender beef with chewy rice noodles and fermented black beans is on the menu. This dish is doused in a fun and tasty dressing featuring salty soy sauce, tart Shaoxing wine, sweet oyster sauce, and a medley of spices. With a sturdy clay pot, Mary then cooks up some savoury Chinese sausage and lays it on a bed of aromatic rice. To top it off, why not some delicious Pineapple Buns? These buns are pillowy and sweet; you'll be surprised to hear that they contain zero pineapple!

programme.title: Vietnamese Street Food
programme.desc: There's nothing more authentic than street food - Vietnamese style! Host Lisa Nguyen shares her tips and tricks on tasty Lemongrass-infused Beef Wraps. A vast array of ingredients including peppery betel leaves, gorgeous greens and crunchy peanuts complement the tenderness of flavoursome, marinated ground beef. Lisa's next dish is an iconic Vietnamese street food - crispy Sizzling Crepes with juicy pork belly and earthy vegetables will definitely activate your taste buds. For dessert, Lisa whips up a batch of sweet coconut pudding using beautiful bananas and velvety coconut milk sprinkled with roasted sesame seeds for some crunch.

programme.title: Sweet and Sour
programme.desc: Sweet and sour are definitely on the menu as Thai-born chef Pailin Chongchitnant whips up glass noodle salad, sour curry, sweet and sour stir fry, and pineapple and lychee in iced syrup.

programme.title: Cantonese Seafood
programme.desc: Bring on the seafood! Home cook Mary Tang kicks off this episode of One World Kitchen 3 with a unique dish featuring chewy clams, sweet and bitter fermented black beans, and a collection of spices. Next, she makes us her favourite shrimp dish - Shrimp and Egg Fried Rice. Fluffy egg bits, lightly flavoured nutty brown rice, and a pop of tender shrimp works wonders for the taste buds. A common appetizer, Mary then walks us through a spicy concoction of deep-fried salt and pepper squid or Calamari. And who doesn't love lobster? Mary finishes off with Cantonese Lobster with Ginger and Scallions (yes, it tastes as good as it sounds!). A Cantonese take on the juicy protein, this dish is fried in hot bubbling oil for a golden-brown crust, and steamed in great Shaoxing wine and salty soy sauce for some flavour.

programme.title: Hanoi Specialties
programme.desc: Simple, fun, and magically tasty, some of Vietnam's most delicious and well-known foods come from its capital city of Hanoi. Vietnamese expert Lisa Nguyen shares her knowledge of Hanoi dishes by starting off with a sweet, sour, and spicy papaya salad called Goi Du Du. With a popular nuoc cham dressing featuring sugar, lime juice and Thai chili drizzled over a medley of crunchy carrots, fresh cilantro and mint, chewy papaya, and shrimp, this dish is the perfect balance of wonderful flavours and textures. Also on the menu, grilled-to-perfection Pork Patties with a rich caramel sauce. Fresh fragrant dill and golden turmeric elevate Lisa's next dish as she cooks up some mahi-mahi to enjoy with a beer. To finish off, Lisa exquisitely prepares Vietnam's most popular dish - Pho.

programme.title: THE BOYS OF H COMPANY
programme.desc: In the war in the Pacific, Iwo Jima was crucial to the U.S. as an air base for long- range bombing missions against mainland Japan. The Japanese knew the island’s importance and spent years "digging in" in preparation for the inevitable U.S. attack. Seizing Iwo Jima was necessary, but the prize would not come easily. On the morning of February 19, 1945, the boys of H Company stormed the beaches at Iwo Jima, along with 60,000 other Marines. Through compelling first person accounts, dramatic recreations and archival footage, this two-hour docudrama follows in the boot steps of the boys of H Company as they fight one of the costliest battles in U.S. History.

programme.title: THE BOYS OF H COMPANY [P13]
programme.desc: In the war in the Pacific, Iwo Jima was crucial to the U.S. as an air base for long- range bombing missions against mainland Japan. The Japanese knew the island’s importance and spent years “digging in” in preparation for the inevitable U.S. attack. Seizing Iwo Jima was necessary, but the prize would not come easily. On the morning of February 19, 1945, the boys of H Company stormed the beaches at Iwo Jima, along with 60,000 other Marines. Through compelling first person accounts, dramatic recreations and archival footage, this two-hour docudrama follows in the boot steps of the boys of H Company as they fight one of the costliest battles in U.S. History.

programme.title: Cinta Pertama Belum Kelar
programme.desc: Raisa (Baiti Syaghaf) returns to her hometown to attend her older sister’s engagement party, only to be hit by a devastating realization: the groom-to-be, Raffi (Alex Rio), is her own ex-boyfriend. To maintain family peace, Raisa desperately tries to hide their past, even as her heart is torn apart.

programme.title: Samudra Cinta
programme.desc: The love story between Ocean and Cinta, which had always quarreled before. Gradually, they became friends and slowly grew in love between them. But a secret between the Cinta family and the Samudra family makes their relationship complicated because there is a big secret about Cinta that can ruin their relationship.

programme.title: Kambing Daliman
programme.desc: he story begins with the success of Baskoro, a former film director who has just been elected as the Regent of Klaten. Daliman, a humble porter at Beringharjo Market, is overjoyed to see Baskoro on TV. Years ago, Daliman worked as an extra for Baskoro and even lent his goat to be slaughtered for a movie scene. Baskoro had promised to pay him back if the film succeeded, but unfortunately, the movie was a total failure. Now that Baskoro is in power, will Daliman get what he’s owed

programme.title: CINTA 2 PILIHAN
programme.desc: Fathir and Sukma are a married couple who live a simple but happy life. Until finally, their beloved daughter Zahra is diagnosed with a serious illness in the midst of their family's financial difficulties. At the same time, Fathir accidentally meets his ex-girlfriend Clara.

programme.title: TITIP RINDU BUAT TUKANG CUKUR
programme.desc: Isah (Andi Viola) is a humble barber who considers herself plain and overweight, while her sister Sofi is a stunning beauty. Despite their differences, both sisters find themselves falling for the same man, Bayu (Qausar Harta). Surprisingly, it's the quirky Isah who seems to attract all the attention.

programme.title: Manis Manis Bau Amis Tapi Suka

programme.title: The Sharksons
programme.desc: Join the Shark Family as they work hard to keep the sea clean! It's a busy day with so much rubbish on the seabed. Stanley Shark becomes his heroic alter-ego, Super Shark, to show everyone how to clean up and recycle properly! The Sharksons show their creativity by using recycled materials to build an amazing underwater ball pit and slide. Plus, see them use teamwork to operate little digger trucks and even fix a broken bus wheel using a sunken bin lid!

programme.title: The Sharksons
programme.desc: Get ready for a super fun underwater sing-along with The Sharksons! Join the fun as five little reef sharks learn their lesson about jumping on the bed. Then, meet an 'Itsy Bitsy' sea spider who keeps trying to climb an underwater cliff with a little help from her friends! The classic rhymes continue with a curious crab acting out the story of Humpty Dumpty and a cozy pajama party with ten friends in a bed. It's a sing-along full of classic tunes with a fun, fishy twist!

programme.title: Playtime With Twinkle
programme.desc: Get ready for a big day of discovery and play with Twinkle and her friends! The fun starts as they learn to play new musical instruments, with Twinkle on drums, Kitty on the sax and Bunny on guitar! Then, it's time to play a fun game of 'Twinkle Says'! Follow along as they give you playful instructions and see if you can keep up. The discoveries continue as the friends find a mirror and make funny faces and wonder what an umbrella is for before it starts to rain!

programme.title: Playtime With Twinkle
programme.desc: It's time to learn all about colors, shapes and numbers with Twinkle! First, learn how to count with Twinkle as she finds five balloons in the colors red, blue, green, yellow and purple! Then, join Twinkle and Sandy the Seagull to make sandcastles, learning different shapes like squares, triangles and circles. The learning continues as Twinkle and her friends build and count a beautiful tower of rainbow stones and discover the variety of shapes that clouds can take in the sky!

programme.title: Dance Party
programme.desc: Get ready for a dance party that's always on the move! Join JJ, Cody and Nina as they groove to 'Wheels on the Bus' while a real bus travels in the background. Then, it's time to line up and pretend to be a train, chugging along to the 'Train Song'! The adventure continues as the kids put on their fire hats and sing about being brave firefighters with a big red firetruck. From the 'Animal Song' to seeing vehicles on the street, it's a high-energy dance party!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: It's story time with JJ's favorite songs and stories! First, sing along to 'Wheels on the Bus' as JJ and his friends put on an interactive show. Then, settle in for some classic tales. Watch as the three little pigs try to build houses strong enough to keep the Big Bad Wolf away. Then, find out who wins a big race: the speedy hare or the slow and steady tortoise! Finally, learn a lesson about working hard with the story of the Grasshopper and the Ants.

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: Go from bathtime to bedtime with Mia and Max! The fun starts with a splashy, bubbly good time as the kids play with their rubber ducks and get nice and clean in the tub. After the bath, it's time to get into pajamas and play a fun game of Peek-a-boo with Mummy using lots of different objects from around the house. Finally, it's time for bed as Daddy and Ella take turns giving Max a cuddle and a teddy bear before he goes to sleep. Night night!

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: Get ready for sweet dreams and goodnight songs! First, Mia giggles with delight as she gathers four of her favorite stuffed animals into bed with her for a fun game of 'Ten in the Bed.' The bedtime fun continues as Maple and Muffin play a game of 'Five Little Monkeys' during their bubble bath. Then, Grandma Panda helps Mia and Bari embark on a fantastic adventure, building a little rocket out of cushions to go on an adventure to the moon!

programme.title: Little Baby Bum: Lullabies
programme.desc: Little Baby Bum is here to help you fall to sleep; with soothing, relaxing animated lullabies. These gentle and sensory videos are accompanied by lullaby versions of much loved nursery rhymes, helping to take you to the land of nod.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: It's time for fun and games with all our friends! First, Jill is shy at her first mermaid swimming class, but she learns to have fun and trust herself with the help of her friends. Then, during a Mexican posada, Manny teaches Baby John how to build a piñata. After he gets over being a little scared of the blindfold, he has lots of fun! The fun continues as the friends learn to compromise when they have opposite ideas for playtime.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Join Baby John as he learns all about yummy food! First, he explores the world of vegetables and learns that they are not only delicious but also essential for staying strong and healthy. Then, the family has fun making and tasting all sorts of delicious and healthy fruit juices. The tasty adventure continues as the kids learn to make colorful popsicles with yummy fruits and Miss Hannah turns healthy fruit into fun animal faces!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: JJ is learning all about how to share, help and be kind! First, he learns the magic words 'please' and 'thank you,' and what to do when you make a mistake. The lessons continue as JJ, YoYo and TomTom show how much fun it is to share their snacks and toys. Being kind also means being helpful, and JJ's family loves to help each other around the house. From using good manners at the table to learning how to wait in line, it's a day of learning to be a good friend and family member!

programme.title: Cody Time
programme.desc: Join Cody for a day filled with all his favorite things! First, Cody gets to live out his dino dreams as he dons a dinosaur costume and pretends to be a monster attacking a toy bridge. The fun continues at school, where he starts playing a guitar and his classmates join in to form their very own rock band! Cody also shows his caring side as he and his friends encounter a lost baby duckling and lead the way to help it find the perfect home.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: It's time to play JJ's favorite games! Join Ms. Appleberry and the Melon Patch kids as they play 'follow the leader' and have a contest to see who can make the silliest funny face. Then, JJ and his animal friends have a party where they play freeze dance! The fun continues with vehicles, as Grandpa makes a cool choo-choo train out of cardboard boxes and the kids play with different construction vehicles in a giant sandpit.

programme.title: Cody Time
programme.desc: Join Cody as he learns how to be a good brother and a good friend! In a heartwarming moment, Cody finds out he's going to be a big brother. After some initial nerves, he spends a special day with his mama and her baby bump. Then, the big day arrives as the family brings his new sister, Kendi, home! Watch Cody take on his new role, helping Kendi get to sleep and learning to play new games together like bouncing a balloon.

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Mom's crazy inventions are going haywire! First, Arpo and Daniel have fun with the new voice-controlled smart house, until it starts having a tantrum and they have to figure out how to calm it down. Then, Mom's new time travel machine accidentally turns a pigeon into a giant pterodactyl, forcing Arpo to catch it! The mayhem continues when Daniel takes a flying smartcrib on a joyride and Arpo has to chase a remote-controlled truck that's gone out of control!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Arpo and Baby Daniel are causing chaos all over town! The adventure starts at the supermarket when Daniel runs off with a giant lollipop, leading to a wild chase with Arpo's rockets on the fritz. Then, a relaxing fishing picnic turns into a wilderness survival test when a thieving squirrel tries to steal their food! Plus, the family gets a mischievous new puppy that Arpo has to keep from making messes and a stroller goes on the loose, forcing Arpo to chase it through town!

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: Go from bathtime to bedtime with Mia and Max! The fun starts with a splashy, bubbly good time as the kids play with their rubber ducks and get nice and clean in the tub. After the bath, it's time to get into pajamas and play a fun game of Peek-a-boo with Mummy using lots of different objects from around the house. Finally, it's time for bed as Daddy and Ella take turns giving Max a cuddle and a teddy bear before he goes to sleep. Night night!

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: There are so many fun things to discover with Mia, Max and their friends! First, they head to the park for some rolling fun as they play Jack and Jill, rolling down the muddy grass and whizzing down the slide! Then, Max gets his first sippy cup and is so excited to show it off that he starts an impromptu tea party with all his playmates. The day of discovery ends with a rainy day competition to see who can make the biggest puddle splash of all!

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: Gecko is busy stopping Mr. Weasel's wacky schemes! First, Gecko and Weasel face off in a football match, but Weasel starts cheating! Gecko must fix his damaged teammates and teach Weasel a lesson. Then, Bobby the Bus's battery goes missing, and all clues point to Weasel! The schemes continue as Weasel tries to show off at a 'fix up fair' but needs rescuing, and he steals cakes from a bake sale but ends up crashing!

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: Gecko and the Mechanicals face a big test of skill and teamwork! First, the Mechs are in Garage School when a real emergency comes in. In a role reversal, they must fix Fiona the Firetruck's starter motor while Gecko instructs them! Then, when Blue crashes during a flying race, Gecko must show his skill to repair him. The day ends with a big American football game where Gecko comes up with a clever strategy and a creative fix to help his team win!

programme.title: Cody Time
programme.desc: What will Cody do today? Every day is a new adventure! He might move to a new house with his family and cat, Pickles. Or maybe he'll find a simple empty cardboard box and use his imagination to turn it into a turtle shell, a drum and a race car! He could go on a hike with JJ and race walnut sailboats, or stay home and sing the ABCs over a big pot of alphabet soup. With Cody, you never know what fun you'll have!

programme.title: CeCe Time
programme.desc: It's CeCe Time, full of kittens, tutus and fun! The big day arrives when CeCe gets her very own adorable kitten! She loves her new friend and wants to put on a show, so she gets in her ballerina outfit to dance for her kitty. Then, after hosting many tea parties for her stuffed animals, CeCe invites her real friends JJ and Bella over for a high tea party! From ice skating with Mom to imagining stick ponies are unicorns, it's always a fun and graceful day with CeCe!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is on adventures big and small, from the mail to outer space! First, Blippi shrinks down to go inside the BlippiMobile's engine to fix a problem. Then, he follows a letter he wrote on its entire journey through the post office to Grandpa Blippi's mailbox! After that, he flies into outer space on a rocket, floating in zero gravity and performing a space walk. He even joins a boulder on its exciting trip down a river to become a grain of sand!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi wants to find out how awesome things work! He and D.BO visit a construction site where they learn all about safety and how a crane works. Then, they meet Frankie the Firetruck to see all of her amazing fire-fighting abilities in action! After that, it's time for some speed as they meet an F1 race car and a giant monster truck to learn what makes them so special. Finally, Blippi shrinks down to see how a guitar makes beautiful music!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is wondering, 'How does it work?!' Join Blippi and his robot buddy FETCH on an adventure to find the answers! Blippi shrinks down to fly inside a beehive and learn how honey is made, and explores a garbage truck to find out why flies love it so much. Then, it's a trip through a factory to see how chocolate is made! The adventure even travels through time as Blippi meets his great-grandpa to see the very first cars. Plus, Blippi and FETCH help a nervous crane learn to build a skyscraper!

programme.title: Lellobee City Farm
programme.desc: It's a day of helping each other at Lellobee City Farm! When a mama songbird's eggs are about to hatch, Mei, Ella and Rishi build her a beautiful bird feeding table so she can take care of her new chicks. Then, when Heidi the Horse is feeling down in the dumps, Ella and all the friends put on a show and give her a big group hug to make her feel happy again! The helping continues as everyone learns the importance of sharing their veggies with a visiting gopher.

programme.title: Lellobee City Farm
programme.desc: Get ready for some creative farm adventures with Ella! First, Ella brings school to Lellobee City Farm by creating a classroom in the Boogie Barn and teaching all her animal friends. Then, she helps Mei make some delicious jam using fresh strawberries, grapes and blueberries from the farm! The creative day ends with a magical night of stargazing, where Mei points out constellations that look just like the animals on the farm.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Let's learn how to be healthy with Baby John! He learns all about the bones that make up his body when he visits the doctor and his friend 'Mr. Skeleton'! Then, after tripping and falling while playing soccer, Baby John learns the tough task of tying his own shoelaces! The health lessons continue as Mom and Dad teach him how to properly sneeze into his arm to keep everyone around him from getting sick.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Being little can be tough, but Baby John is growing up! First, he thinks he's ready to be big and make all his own decisions, but Mom and Dad help him understand that being little is pretty awesome, too! Then, Mom helps Baby John learn how to express all his different emotions and feelings, from grumpy to happy to proud. When Baby John loses his pacifier, the whole family joins in to help him on the big search!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Join JJ and his friends for a fun school day at Melon Patch Academy! Ms. Appleberry finds exciting ways to learn, like using building blocks and drawings to practice the alphabet. Then, the kids play a fun guessing game to learn all about the five senses and how to sign them in ASL! The learning continues as they sing about the days of the week, play a fun alphabet photo game on a rainy day and enjoy story time with the whole family. It's a day packed with learning and fun!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Join JJ for a guide to staying healthy and happy!
